hypothesis: On current main, the already-async Python prewarm is correct for paint, but concurrent first-touch callers can consume and lose the in-flight startup handle, causing duplicate interpreter launches and lifecycle races.
approach: TS-parity-first source audit; replayed the base double-start on a Prime VM before edits. Replaced the consumed startup JoinHandle with a shared watch receiver in pa-core/kernel/provisioner.rs, froze predecessor stop gate at startup creation across retries, and added four integration fixtures for join/error cause, waiter abort, stop, and dispose during boot. Frozen unrelated surfaces unchanged. REVIEW-FIX AMENDMENT (successor worker perf-kernel-async-boot2, at 7ddb838a4): F1 panic wedge - the boot is isolated behind its own JoinHandle inside the publisher task, which ALWAYS clears the startup memo and sends the result; a panicked boot (incl. a panicking progress listener) becomes a 'kernel startup task failed' StartupFailure and the listener state is cleared, so the next ensure() re-arms fresh; the watch now carries Option<StartupResult> itself (settled_manager and the write-only last_startup_failure removed). F2 stop-gate gap - pending_stop installs atomically in the same state lock that takes the manager, closing the two-lock TOCTOU where a revival captured the previous gate. F3 - the dispose leg pins the absolute interpreter count at dispose-return (==1; the abort cancels the retry). Same-family honesty: a dispose-raced boot now rejects with 'Kernel provisioner disposed during startup' (TS startKernel abort cause) instead of handing callers a dead manager, and joined callers keep the boot's manager when a concurrent stop takes the live owner (TS managerPromise)
parity_notes: TS interactive-mode.ts:1858 starts UI without waiting; agent-session.ts:10900-10908 prewarms asynchronously; tools/ipython.ts:462-482 shares managerPromise and :638 awaits it at first touch. Existing Rust create/background prewarm preserved; shared startup watch makes concurrent Rust callers join one in-flight boot, retains true failure message, keeps abort local to waiter, and lets stop/dispose await the same boot. No new async paint cut. Amendment (F4 accuracy): the race proof of record is the served-path slow-wrapper oracle - base 2/2 in-flight trials launched two interpreters before the first completed; candidate 9/9 launched one (sha-verified archive kaboot-pty-evidence.tar.gz a71e14c1...); fixture-replay start-count figures are VM-only synthetic oracles and are not cited as the archived proof. The shared-startup first-touch anchor is tools/ipython.ts:638 (managerPromise awaited at first touch); agent-session.ts:10900-10908 is the prewarm anchor only
